pull.title: KAFKA-15853: Move KafkaConfig to server module
pull.body:
### WIP - fixing test cases
### Notes:
- [x]  Moving any object companion and interfaces that KafkaConfigs depends on outside of core. 
  - `Session`, and `SocketServer ` moved to `org.apache.kafka.network`
  - `AuthorizerUtils` moved to `org.apache.kafka.security.utils`
  - `KafkaRaftServer`, `PasswordEncoder`  moved to `org.apache.kafka.server`
  - `ClientQuotaManagerConfig`, `DynamicConfig`, `ReplicationQuotaManagerConfig`  moved to `org.apache.kafka.server.config`
  - `LogCleaner` moved to `org.apache.kafka.server.config.LogCleanerConfig`. It can't move to `storage` without creating Circular dependency. 
  - `TransactionLogConfig` moved to `org.apache.kafka.coordinator.transaction`
  - `OffsetConfig` moved to `org.apache.kafka.coordinator.group`
  - some of `CoreUtils` functionality is duplicated in `org.apache.kafka.utils`
  - some of `TestUtils` functionality is duplicated in `org.apache.kafka.server.utils`

- [x] Introduce interfaces to reduce moving dependencies out of core and reduce the changes in this pr
  - `ReconfigurableServer` to avoid depending on `Broker` and `Controller` 
  - `DynamicBrokerConfigManager` and `DynamicBrokerConfigBaseManager` to avoid depending directly on `DynamicBrokerConfig` 
  - `KafkaZKClient` to avoid any depend ices on `KafaZKClient`


### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation 
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
